static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的配偶可交流Work压力,但难以表达'失败感'和Self-doubt;因加班与自我批评,Family relationships一度紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before;职业受挫时曾出现类似失败与Self-doubt体验
static_traits.language_features: Speaks clearly and fairly organized; can cooperate in exploring automatic thoughts; positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 由于not yet获得Work中的晋升,来访者产生'我是一事without成的失败者'的感受,伴随明显的Self-doubt与without价值感,难以接纳任何成就.
basic_info.core_demands: Self-critical thinking has affected mental health and relationships with family, thus hoping to relieve the impact of these negative thoughts through counseling.
growth_experiences: 过去在职业生涯遭遇挫折时,常出现强烈的失败感与Self-doubt;not yet曾寻求心理治疗支持;长期投入Work并在压力下加班,逐渐形成'通过更努力Work来证明自己'的倾向.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not够胜任
My worth depends on whether I am promoted and on achievements

special_situations.event: not yet获晋升的决定公布后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not被晋升,就说明I am not good enough,等同于失败.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extends working hours and works harder to 'compensate' and prove oneself.

special_situations.event: When facing work tasks and pressing deadlines in daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现一个挫折,就证明以往的成绩not算数,说明I am not good enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视积极反馈与既往成就,过度关注not足与错误.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 每个任务都在提醒I am not good enough.

special_situations.event: 在经历一次职业挫折后回想整体Career development
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败意味着今后都会失败,I will never succeed.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-denial,降低Anticipation,难以接纳已有成绩.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管怎么努力,I will never succeed.

special_situations.event: 考虑是否向配偶表达自己的失败感与Self-doubt时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达脆弱,他们可能not理解或会看轻我.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking about feelings, keeps distance from the spouse to reduce the chance of being judged.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们可能会看not起我或not理解我.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, wants to be seen for one's worth and ability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,被看轻,担心失败导致失去他人的尊重与亲密
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over failure through self-criticism and overtime work
Avoids exposing vulnerability to intimate partners (such as a spouse) to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的,随时可能失败的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 他人(上级/配偶)是评判者,可能not理解或会贬低我

object_relations.self_representation: A burden-bearer in the family, a person who finds it hard to share vulnerability
object_relations.object_representation: 配偶可能会not理解或看轻我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被建议向配偶分享关于失败感与Self-doubt的真实感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识认为对方会not理解或会看轻自己(将Self-denialProjection到他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以担忧的口吻,use'他们会...'等猜测性语言,回避具体事实与证据,减少自我暴露.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Work受挫(如not yet获晋升)并感到强烈失败与愤怒时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将失败归咎于自身的全面not行,将外在失望转为自我指责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我批评语句(如'It is all my fault''I am not good enough'),语气低落,并通过加班等自我施压行为来'惩罚'自己.

manifestations: Strongly binds self-worth to promotions and external achievements
挫折后难以接纳既往成就,感到'I have no value'
难以向配偶分享失败与Self-doubt,担心被not理解或看轻
Growing sense of alienation from family under work stress
outcomes: Declining subjective sense of support; intensifying emotional distress

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向配偶表达脆弱情绪,转而加班与自我苛责
Handles the emotions brought by frustration through self-criticism and extended working hours

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When in contact with others, overly worries about being judged, cautiously avoids exposing vulnerability

positive_force: 配偶具备支持性,愿意ListeningWork压力
Past performance and team respect reflect real ability and achievement
Positive attitude, willing to explore and challenge automatic thoughts
Has successfully managed several large projects; has evidence of competence
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization,心理过滤,个人化,读心术等认知扭曲
将自我价值与晋升高度绑定,易negate积极证据
过度加班与忽视自我照料,导致Tense family relationships与身心耗竭
Self-criticism is prominent; it is hard to express vulnerability in intimate relationships, and support acquisition is limited

target_behavior.behavior: Works excessive overtime, neglecting self-care and rest
antecedent: not yet获晋升的挫折情境
Facing dense work tasks and deadlines
target_behavior.core_reason: Binds self-worth to external achievements, trying to 'compensate' for failure by working harder and maintain a sense of control
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame; seeks external validation and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships,心理耗竭,Work performance affected,长期缺乏休假与自我关怀

target_behavior.behavior: 自我批评与negate既往成就的自动化思维
antecedent: 想到not yet获晋升的情境
When performing work tasks or receiving feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 核心信念'I am a failure''I am not good enough'驱动,过滤掉积极证据
target_behavior.function: 以自责维系对挫折的Interpretation,减少not确定性与外部评判的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem,Decreased drive,难以客观评估表现与接纳正向反馈

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与配偶分享失败感与Self-doubt
antecedent: When advised or thinking of communicating inner feelings with spouse
Noticing a sense of distance when interacting with family
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被not理解或被看轻(读心术),害怕暴露脆弱
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and possible conflict, maintaining surface stability
target_behavior.consequence: 亲密Relationship estrangement,支持资源减少,Loneliness感加重
